channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from morningNewsSection1, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Immigration arrests surge to 50,000 in July
item.description: Under DHS Secretary Markwayne Mullin, immigration enforcement has shifted from the confrontational approach of his predecessor, leading to a record number of arrests.

item.title: Millions gather in Karbala, Iraq for Shia pilgrimage
item.description: Pilgrims from around the world, including many from Iraq and Iran, walked hundreds of miles in extreme heat to participate in the August event.

item.title: Judge allows Postal Service to proceed with Trump's mail-in voting order for now
item.description: A Boston federal judge lifted a nationwide injunction that had halted USPS work on the president's directive to restrict mail-in voting.

item.title: Trump's beef plan unlikely to cut hamburger costs much, experts say
item.description: The proposal arrives weeks before midterms, with food prices and living costs expected to be key voter concerns.
